summary.goal: Implement endpoint for Orchestrator to submit change requests during execution
summary.context: When Orchestrator discovers the plan is inadequate (missing steps, wrong dependencies), it can request changes. This creates a new draft version, NOT mutation of approved version.

acceptance_criteria.description: Change request includes reason and suggested_changes
Creates new draft version based on published version
Links new draft to change request for traceability

steps.title: Define ChangeRequest entity
steps.description: Create src/domain/change-request.ts with ChangeRequest interface and schema.

acceptance_criteria.description: ChangeRequest has id, run_id, plan_id, reason
ChangeRequest has status: pending, applied, rejected

steps.title: Add change request storage
steps.description: Extend SQLite storage with change_requests table and CRUD operations.

steps.title: Link versions to change requests
steps.description: Add change_request_id field to PlanVersion to track which change request triggered it.

acceptance_criteria.description: Query to find versions by change_request_id

steps.title: Implement POST /runs/:run_id/change-requests endpoint
steps.description: Create endpoint to accept change requests from Orchestrator.

acceptance_criteria.description: Accepts reason and suggested_changes in body
Creates new draft version from latest published
Links new version to change request

steps.title: Apply suggested changes to new version
steps.description: Implement logic to apply suggested_changes to the new draft version.

acceptance_criteria.description: add_steps adds new steps to version

steps.title: Add change request query endpoints
steps.description: Create GET endpoints to query change requests by plan or run.

acceptance_criteria.description: Includes linked version info in response

steps.title: Add integration tests for change requests
steps.description: Write integration tests for change request creation and application.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tests verify new version is created
Tests verify suggested changes are applied
